course_name_original: Linear algebra, analytical and differential geometry
course_name_en: Linear algebra, analytical and differential geometry

learning_outcomes.text: Formation of higher mathematical bases necessary for the mathematical modeling of engineering physical processes. Formation of capacities and development of calculation skills through the use of interdisciplinary connections, effectively utilizing the indicated specialized bibliography.
Ensuring professional competences to apply knowledge acquired through the course topics in solving engineering problems with interdisciplinary connections.

syllabus_topics: Line and plane in space. Surfaces of revolution.
Frenet frame. Curvature. Torsion. Tangent plane. Normal to a surface.
assessment_rules: The final grade is based on a written exam (2/3 of the grade) and the submission of 2 applied evaluation papers (1/3 of the grade). A minimum performance standard is required to pass the discipline.
